reviewer: AI assistant, condition-blind visual review; not an independent human annotation panel
scope: Completed coarse visual review of all 100 paired all-decision head-camera storyboards, supplemented by the original sparse three-camera panels for hanging_mug. Stage labels describe visible problems, NOT proven causes or final success. Unknown includes no visible problem before the last recorded action. Explicit condition/outcome mapping not read during annotation; trajectory lengths remain visible and may indirectly reveal outcomes. Not a frame-by-frame wrist-camera, numeric action, contact-force or terminal-state audit.
confidence_policy: Known stages: moderate confidence in coarse visible phase only. Unknown: not assessable. No calibrated probabilities or inter-rater reliability claimed.
frame_reference_policy: frames lists highlighted decision indices for the paired panel, not a claim that both arms have each frame. Grey missing frames provide no physical evidence.
